# Golden Flowers

> Golden Flowers is a Lake Tahoe wedding florist creating elevated, sustainably grown floral artistry for couples getting married across the Sierra Nevada. Brittany, the owner and lead designer, is an artist and an agronomist with a master's degree in agronomy. The studio buys from local and regional Northern California farms first and grows a small plot of specialty cut flowers. The studio caps its calendar each season and intentionally takes fewer weddings than most studios, so each wedding gets weeks of sourcing and design work.

Key facts:
- Based in Incline Village, Nevada, by appointment only. Phone: (530) 557-7689.
- Serves North and South Lake Tahoe, Truckee, Incline Village, Olympic Valley, Nevada City, Grass Valley, and the greater Sierra Nevada.
- Design is foam-free and seasonal, with reusable mechanics and locally grown stems.
- Couples start by sharing their date and venue through the consultation form, and the studio replies by email or text.

## Services

Full-service wedding floral design, built custom for each wedding with no packages: bridal and bridesmaid bouquets, ceremony installations and arches, reception centerpieces and tablescapes, and personal flowers such as boutonnieres and corsages. Weddings begin at $5,000. A typical 100 guest wedding runs $10,000 to $16,000, and larger guest counts with multiple installations run above $20,000. Every wedding is quoted individually.

## Design philosophy

- Every wedding designed individually around its venue, season and palette, with no packages or set styles
- Seasonal flowers, bought from Northern California growers first, plus a small plot of specialty cut flowers the studio grows itself
- Foam-free, with reusable mechanics and composting
- Arrangements designed to belong in the Sierra Nevada landscape and to hold up in mountain conditions: wind, altitude, heat, and full sun

## Venues

Golden Flowers designs regularly at Edgewood Tahoe, The Ritz-Carlton Lake Tahoe at Northstar, Thunderbird Lodge, Palisades High Camp, Martis Camp, Schaffer's Camp, the Hyatt Regency Lake Tahoe, the Hellman-Ehrman Mansion at Sugar Pine Point, the North Tahoe Event Center, Gar Woods Grill & Pier, Heavenly, Old Greenwood, Valhalla Tahoe, The Miner's Foundry, the National Exchange Hotel, and private estates across the region.
